english.note: Use this when the analogy is an illustrative comparison used to explain an idea.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a figure of speech or a particular figurative expression.

examples.english: This analogy makes it easy to understand, explaining the complicated concept as if it were building blocks.
examples.traditional: 呢個比喻好易明，將個複雜概念講到好似砌積木咁。

examples.english: His saying that time is money is a vivid metaphor.
examples.traditional: 佢成日話時間就係金錢，呢個比喻好生動。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 si4 gaan1 zau6 hai6 gam1 cin4 ni1 go3 bei2 jyu6 hou2 saang1 dung6

english.note: Use 比喻 as the all-purpose term, especially for a religious or moral story such as one told by Jesus.

examples.english: Jesus told this parable to teach people to forgive others.
examples.traditional: 耶穌講過呢個比喻，教人要寬恕別人。
